name: Argentina: monotributistas and responsables inscriptos

facts: Compensatory interest on late tax, high in nominal terms; formal fines on top

tests: Becomes resident after 12 months of continuous presence (or with permanent residence status)

source.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Argentina, residence

calendar.note: IVA is filed and paid monthly, between about the 18th and 25th of the next month depending on the CUIT; the vault uses the 25th. Monotributo is paid by the 20th of each month. The annual Ganancias return and payment fall in mid-June of the next year (the vault uses 30 June).

workdays.note: Not verified whether deadlines here move off weekends and holidays. Kyros shows the last working day on or before the legal date, so paying on it is always in time, and keeps the reserve locked until the next working day after it.

presets.label: Responsable inscripto: IVA 21% + Ganancias and autónomos reserve 30%
Exported services (no IVA charged) + Ganancias and autónomos reserve 30%
Monotributo: reserve 10%; the check uses the fee of your category

items.name: monotributo
items.label: Monotributo, services: 12 times the monthly fee of the category for your annual revenue (categories A to K, values from August 2026: tax, SIPA pension and health insurance)

notes: Fees and caps are updated every February and August with inflation; these are the August 2026 to January 2027 values. Above ARS 126,610,838.75 a year (category K) the monotributo no longer applies and the general regime (IVA and Ganancias) does.

items.name: autonomos
items.label: Autónomos (SIPA pension): at least category I, ARS 78,271.56 a month from October 2026; categories II to V pay ARS 109,578.51 to 344,390.34

items.name: ganancias
items.label: Ganancias 2026, art. 94 annual scale (5% to 35%), after the ganancia no imponible (ARS 6,019,671.36) and the special deduction for the self-employed (ARS 21,068,849.78)

notes: Ganancias uses ARCA's annual 2026 tables (art. 94 scale and art. 30 deductions, updated with the January to June inflation). Family deductions and the higher special deduction for new professionals are not included.

Autónomos contributions are a fixed monthly amount by category, updated monthly; the estimate counts category I. If you pay a higher category, enter the difference as a fixed contribution: it is deducted before Ganancias too.

Reserve estimates: Ganancias for responsables inscriptos from ARCA's annual 2026 scale; the monotributo from the fee of the category that matches annual revenue. Both are indexed to inflation twice a year, so the pack is reviewed every February and August.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
